detail.description: Reveals your life's purpose, the path you are meant to walk, and the core lessons you will encounter.
Describes your natural talents, abilities, and the way you interact with the world around you.
Reflects your inner desires, motivations, and what your heart truly yearns for.
Shows how others perceive you and the outer mask you present to the world.
Highlights a special talent or ability you possess from birth.
Represents the person you are becoming and the goals you strive toward in later life.
Indicates how you handle stress and maintain harmony in your daily life.
Points to unresolved lessons from past experiences that you must address in this lifetime.
Unveils the strengths you rely on most and the talents you may not fully recognize.
